QuestInfo.name: The Knight and the Elf
QuestInfo.0: Vel the Cygnus Knight has a question for you. Since he's never seen an Elven village before, he's curious. Why don't you meet him in Elluel?
QuestInfo.1: Vel saw Elder of War Danika training, and wonders how old she must be to command such strength.
QuestInfo.2: Vel was shocked to hear Danika's age. Elves and humans had less in common than he realized...

0.0: Greetings, Majesty! I'm Vel, one of the knights stationed in your lovely town. I'm happy to report all's well!\r\n#L0##bThank you for the report, sir knight.#l\n#k
0.1: That's what I'm here for, isn't it? To be honest, there hasn't been a whole lot to do. Oh! I did see Danika training a few days ago, and...WOW! She can fight!\r\n#L0##b(She's training to get her old strength back, just like you!)#l\n#k
0.2: I've never seen such grace and skill! It's like she's got lifetimes of experience! I gotta know, how old is she?

yes.0: She's so tiny, but she used that great bow like it was nothing. You're amazing too, of course, Majesty, but I wasn't expecting anything like that from Danika! So, tell me, really. How old IS she?

no.0: Okay, okay. Maybe that was a little rude...

1.0: Why, I bet she's almost as good as Irena. So, how old is she?\r\n#L0##bIf you don't count the time she was asleep, she's about 240 years old.#l\n#k
1.1: Heh, I think there's something wrong with my ears. How old did you say? 24?\r\n#L0##b240 years old. She's still a baby, isn't she?#l\n#k
1.2: 240 years old...baby? Did I hear you wrong? I mean, even 24 years is old for a baby... I need to get my ears checked.

yes.0: (Vel mumbles to himself. He must be impressed that Danika became the Elder of War at such a young age!)

quest.0: Do you know Danika's age, Majesty? Ah, I guess you're too busy for such thoughts.
